en: Each man has his own vocation; his talent is his call. There is one direction in which all space is open to him.
zh: 每个人都有自己的天职，天赋就是召唤；总有一个方向，整片天地都为他敞开。
line: Each man has his own vocation; his talent is his call. There is one direction in which all space is open to him. — Ralph Waldo Emerson

word.zh: vt. 取回，恢复，重回，复得
word.ex: He regained consciousness and was able to talk.
word.exzh: 他恢复了意识，还能开口说话了。
